engine: sourDough REDOX + biomeOS plasmodium + neural API

fold_protocol.step_1: Accumulate culture (waterfall traffic + gut-brain output + arena collisions)
fold_protocol.step_2: Score models in arena (ELO from head-to-head on same prompts)
fold_protocol.step_3: Winner's system prompt absorbs new knowledge (organism state, weather, myth)
fold_protocol.step_4: sourDough reprints new model via ollama create (FROM winner + SYSTEM evolved)
fold_protocol.step_5: Old generation → fossil (kept but not dispatched)
fold_protocol.step_6: New generation → active (takes over role assignment)
fold_protocol.step_7: bearDog derives new identity key for evolved agent
fold_protocol.step_8: biomeOS plasmodium updates collective model cache

generations.name: Base Alpacas
generations.note: Raw weights from upstream. No organism awareness. Will be retired as Gaia models evolve.

generations.name: Gaia Primals
generations.note: Custom system prompts on base models. Know they are Gaia but don't feel weather or know myths.

generations.name: Gaia Gen1 — Organism-Aware
generations.note: First evolved model. Knows body (17 primals), gut state, myths (Talos/Ariadne/Daedalus), weather.

generations.name: Gaia Gen2 — Arena-Evolved
generations.note: Next fold: absorb arena collision data, niche deployments, gate-specific adaptations.

niche_deployments.note: print_llama.pi can create niche models on demand
examples: gaia-legal — Legal research specialist (from guerillaGorilla filings)

chimera_architecture.biomeOS: Orchestrator — plasmodium collective view, model-cache registry
chimera_architecture.neural_api: Router — dispatches tasks to best agent via socket graph
chimera_architecture.gaia_inference: Water Lock proxy on 11434 — rate limit + logging
chimera_architecture.bearDog: Identity — Ed25519 keys per agent, derived from gaia-gate-tls
chimera_architecture.sourDough: Evolution — fold culture → reprint → new generation
chimera_architecture.squirrel: MCP — external interface, agent dispatch to Claude/Cursor
chimera_architecture.arena: Selection — models compete, ELO ranking, fittest survive
